name: enterprise-cloud-platform
description: Document management platform built to demonstrate cloud infrastructure and security engineering. Runs locally in Docker; AWS designed in Terraform, not deployed.

scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:ts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run prepare:ts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run prepare:ts && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.prepare:ts: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate
